causal_protocol: Only original authenticated099 FIT package and next16 sampler entries; no DEV/TEST access; explicit owner/clock/state inputs through checkpoint preserve gradients; identical original trained weights and AdamW moments before each policy.
checkpoint_policy: Archive both original continuation policies per fixed seed with all optimizer/RNG state, exact per-step gradient/model/moment/logit/native-state digests, fresh-process actualFIT replays; retain every failure.
execution_comparison: same source/model with native vs nonreentrant full-forward activation checkpointing; extra compute measured, no architecture claim
measurement_correction: One documented replay from original099 parents with detached saved-tensor measurement views; not model/quality tuning; first attempt retained and physicalRSS unqualified.
